thread:
marco_prod: Quick sync from the design review: our in-product docs panel doesn't handle localized headings well. If a user with fr-FR locale opens the panel and we deep-link to #rate-limits it doesn't match because the docs headings are localized and the IDs were auto-generated from English text.
jen_docs: Oof yeah. We currently rely on auto-id generation (slugify the heading text). That breaks for translated headings. We should switch to stable, language-agnostic IDs (e.g., data-id=rate-limits) and update the build to keep those ids consistent across locales.
kai_frontend: Implementation notes: front-end expects anchor -> document.getElementById(anchor). If IDs change per-locale, deep link fails. Plan: 1) docs team to add explicit id attributes in source (canonical ids), 2) front-end to prefer data-doc-id on triggers, 3) support a mapping file docs/anchors.json for backwards compatibility. Rough dev estimate: 1d.
olivia_a11y: Accessibility implications: when the panel opens via deep link, aria-labelledby should refer to the canonical id so screen readers announce the right heading in any locale. Also ensure the anchor target is focusable (tabindex=-1) and we set focus.
ben_sre: Heads up on caching: our CDN caches localized HTML per-path, but the mapping file must be versioned with the docs deploy so the console and docs stay in sync. If console reads an old anchors.json we'll 404 or jump to nothing. Suggest we bake the anchors map into the docs deploy artifact and fetch it by hash.
jen_docs: Good call. I'll add anchors.json to the docs artifact and include a small migration: generate canonical ids from frontmatter `id: rate-limits` when present, else fallback to slugify. Will add notes to the localization guide for translators: avoid changing id field.
kai_frontend: On the console side I'll add a tiny resolver: on open, if direct getElementById fails, check anchors.json aliases and try that id, then pushState('#id') so the URL reflects canonical anchor. Also handle ?help= and # anchor on initial load.
olivia_a11y: QA checklist: keyboard-only entry, screen reader announcement of "Opened Docs: Rate limits" (localized), focus trap, back button returns focus to trigger. Also check that announcing uses localized heading text while the id remains stable.
marco_prod: Analytics: add event `in_product_docs_open` with fields {source, doc_id, locale}. We want to see whether localized users reach the intended section or trigger fallback alias.
ui-bot: CI: docs PR created by jen_docs (PR #424). Frontend branch by kai_frontend (WIP).
marco_prod: Thanks all. Priority P2 for next sprint. Jen, please coordinate anchors.json hash with ben_sre so we don't ship out-of-sync. I'll follow up on the PR comment thread for copy/localization signoff. :shipit:
